$comment: Settings for tools/photo/wear.py: one generated person wearing one real, cleaned frame. Portrait coordinates (boxes, polygons, crop) are in the generated image's own pixels.

portrait_source.prompt:
Studio portrait against a black backdrop. Head and shoulders, the head centered in the upper half of the frame. One hard key light from the front, a little to the camera's left and a little above eye level, no fill: the far side of the face falls into shadow. 85 mm lens, eye level.
A 26-year-old Northern European man, very lean with a long neck and narrow shoulders. Very pale skin with a cool pink undertone. Ash-blond hair in a short crop, close at the sides, a little longer at the front; ears that stand slightly out from the head. Gaunt angular face, hollow cheeks, a very sharp jaw, a long straight nose, thin lips. Clean-shaven. Still and unsmiling, mouth closed.
Wardrobe: a fine black merino crew-neck sweater, no logos.
Head facing the camera, chin level, eyes open, looking just past the camera.
No glasses or sunglasses, nothing on or near the face, temples and ears clear of hands and objects.
Photograph, natural skin texture, no retouching. No text, no logos.
